records.text: Andrew Breitbart died on March 1, 2012, at age 43 from an apparent heart attack.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: It was March 1st of 2012 when Andrew Breitbart dropped dead from an apparent heart attack. ... because Andrew Breitbart was a powerhouse. He was in his prime, just 43.

verification.notes: Contemporaneous reporting confirms Andrew Breitbart died March 1, 2012, at age 43; the Los Angeles coroner attributed his death to heart failure from coronary disease, consistent with the episode's qualified 'apparent heart attack' wording.

sources.title: Conservative bloggers remember Andrew Breitbart
sources.relevance: Confirms Breitbart's March 1, 2012 death at age 43 and the coroner's heart-disease finding.

records.text: The Los Angeles coroner's office was corrupt when it handled Andrew Breitbart's autopsy.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: but something funny happened. A lot of funny things actually happened surrounding his death. The first and foremost utterly corrupt Los Angeles coroner's office conducted an autopsy because people were thinking,

verification.notes: The assertion that the Los Angeles coroner's office was corrupt in this autopsy is unsupported by specific evidence and is not independently testable as stated.

records.text: Forensic technician Michael Cormier was involved with Andrew Breitbart's autopsy and later died from military-grade arsenic poisoning.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I kid you not, his name was Michael Cormier. He was 61 years old. And for whatever reason, he decided after being involved with this autopsy to ingest military-grade arsenic poisoning.

verification.notes: Cormier died from arsenic poisoning, but LAPD and the coroner's office explicitly said he did not work on Breitbart's autopsy and had no connection to it. No reliable source supports the 'military-grade' qualifier.

sources.title: No Answers in Death of Technician Linked to Andrew Breitbart
sources.relevance: Reports arsenic poisoning while explaining that official records did not connect Cormier to Breitbart's autopsy.

sources.title: Coroner's office speaks on Breitbart mystery
sources.relevance: Quotes LAPD and coroner officials explicitly denying that Cormier worked on the Breitbart autopsy.

records.text: Andrew Breitbart hired 28-year-old Ben Shapiro as Breitbart editor-at-large two weeks before Breitbart died.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: But just two weeks before he died, Andrew (Andrew Breitbart) hired a then 28-year-old Ben Shapiro to be the editor-at-large of Breitbart.

verification.notes: Shapiro's contemporaneous resignation statement and later interview confirm he joined Breitbart News as editor-at-large two weeks before Andrew Breitbart's death; Shapiro was 28.

sources.title: Shapiro Resigns From Breitbart News
sources.relevance: Publishes Shapiro's contemporaneous statement that he joined Breitbart News two weeks before Andrew Breitbart died.

sources.title: Ben Shapiro — FRONTLINE interview
sources.relevance: Shapiro recounts joining Breitbart in February 2012 and his history with Andrew Breitbart.

records.text: Candace Owens said that, if Ben Shapiro is to be believed, Andrew Breitbart had known Shapiro since he was 17 and mentored him.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Now, if Ben (Ben Shapiro) is to be believed, Andrew (Andrew Breitbart) had known him since he was just 17 years old. Andrew (Andrew Breitbart) had mentored Ben (Ben Shapiro), but he didn't hire him to work at Breitbart until he was 28.

verification.notes: Shapiro's public resignation statement says he met Breitbart at 17 and remained his friend until Breitbart's death; Shapiro has also publicly described Breitbart as a mentor.

sources.relevance: Shapiro's own published statement says he met Breitbart at 17 and remained his friend until Breitbart's death.

sources.title: Ben Shapiro — FRONTLINE interview
sources.relevance: Shapiro describes Breitbart's long-standing mentorship and their relationship.

records.text: An internal battle over Breitbart News's direction followed Andrew Breitbart's death.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: There was an internal war that waged about what the direction of this healthy conservative company would be.

verification.notes: Contemporaneous reporting and Shapiro's later account document a sustained internal conflict over Breitbart News's direction and Steve Bannon's leadership after Andrew Breitbart died.

sources.title: Breitbart exodus highlights schism over Trump within conservative media
sources.relevance: Contemporaneous reporting documents the internal split over Breitbart's direction and Bannon's leadership.

records.text: Ben Shapiro accused Steve Bannon of betraying Andrew Breitbart's mission by backing Corey Lewandowski, who Shapiro said allegedly assaulted Michelle Fields, at Fields's expense.
records.speaker: Ben Shapiro

appearances.snippet: Breitbart News under the chairmanship of Steve Bannon has put a stake through the heart of Andrew (Andrew Breitbart)'s legacy. ... In order to protect Trump's bully campaign manager, Corey Lewandowski, who allegedly assaulted Michelle (Michelle Fields).

verification.notes: Shapiro's published resignation statement accused Bannon of betraying Andrew Breitbart's mission and protecting Trump and Lewandowski at Fields's expense.

sources.title: Shapiro Resigns From Breitbart News
sources.relevance: Publishes the quoted accusations against Bannon and Breitbart management.

records.text: Candace Owens accused Ben Shapiro of trying to take over Breitbart after Andrew Breitbart died and plotting to take down the company after failing
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I should mention young and under very suspicious circumstances, Ben (Ben Shapiro) attempted to take over Andrew (Andrew Breitbart)'s company. And when that failed, he plotted to take down the company because why can't he have it? Doesn't matter if he builds it, it should be his.

verification.notes: The source-scoped transcript context at 00:05:49 records Owens making this accusation. The episode transcript and a contemporaneous report of Bannon's AmericaFest remarks independently establish the conveyance; this result does not treat the underlying takeover allegation as adjudicated fact.
